integrity: Two fully specified independent finite verification programs and their observed outputs are included. Full external audit and publication priority certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary zero forcing on P_3 Cartesian P_n for n>=3, with the all-length structural result for n>=5. Only one-vertex exchanges among optimal three-vertex sets are permitted. Numerical finite checks do not substitute for the degree/first-force and prefix proof.
title: End-local rigidity and a sharp exchange-disconnection threshold for three-row grids
